messages:
elaine: Heads-up: Commercial wants a clear decision on "burst allowance" semantics for reserved pools before we ship GA. They want to know if credits roll over, how short guaranteed bursts are, and what happens when burst is used up.
tom: We have three product options:
1) No rollover, fixed daily window(s).
2) Rollover within billing period (monthly cap).
3) On-demand burst bought as add-on with SLA.
Which do we prefer for GA?
sara: From CS: most pilots expect rollover at least weekly, otherwise customers feel constrained. But billing hates carryover complexity. Suggest 2 as default, opt-out to 1.
ben: Engineering note: supporting rollover requires tracking "credit_bucket" per tenant and adds contention on write paths. We can batch updates but need to set expectations on accuracy window (eventual consistency ~30s).
miles: Ops: whatever we do, we must include explicit audit events and an admin endpoint to adjust credits: POST /admin/credits/{tenant}/adjust with reason param. Also need a safe-mode that prevents credits > purchased_total.
elainE: (typo) Elaine: Good catch, will update. Also legal needs exact expiry language. If we do option 2, propose wording: "Unused burst credits roll over to the following billing month up to 100% of monthly allocation and expire at the end of the invoicing period beyond that." Thoughts?
sara: Customers like rollover but hate expiry surprises. Could we implement a UI warning and email 7 days before expiry?
tom: Yes. Add to comms. Also product decision: guaranteed micro-window length. Engineers say 30s warms KV caches; some customers want 60s. Can we make the default 30s with configurable contracted-burst-window?
ben: Implementation detail: contracted-burst-window needs to be enforceable at token-level when scheduling; we'll implement a lease token that expires server-side. Should be fine.
miles: Runbook requirements:
- telemetry: tag events with burst_source=[contracted|earned|on_demand] and credit_change_reason.
- alert: if >2 tenants hit hard-cap within 5m, page SRE.
- emergency: /admin/tenants/{id}/limit?mode=throttle and /admin/tenants/{id}/drain. Audit event must include caller.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reserve-burst-service v1 scheduled deploy to staging at 2025-08-14T01:00Z.
elaine: On rollout gating, propose: 1) GA gate: no more than 1 critical SLO breach caused by burst in a week across all canary tenants, 2) Billing reconciliation differences < 0.2% between ledger and meter.
tom: Add metric: billing_reconcile_delta_ratio and alert if >0.002 over 24h.
sara: CS wants sample contract phrasing. Draft: "Customer is allocated X burst credits per period. Unused credits may roll over up to the monthly cap. Credits expire after two billing cycles unless renewed by mutual agreement." Please weigh in.
ben: Legal might push for shorter expiry; operations prefers 1 cycle. Suggest compromise: expiry after one month with optional enterprise rolling.
elaine: OK let's mark as decision: default=rollover up to 100% for one month, expire after one additional billing cycle unless enterprise term says otherwise. Add to PR for legal review.
miles: For telemetry, I'll add prometheus metric names: reserved_burst_used_total{tenant}, reserved_burst_earned_total, reserved_burst_expired_total, reserved_burst_reconcile_diff.
tom: For canary selection, ask SRE to pick low-risk tenants: pick 3 with different patterns (steady, spikey, regional). Any suggestions?
sara: Recommend: Acme-Alpha (spikey), BetaRetail (steady), NapaBank-priv (regional). I'll ask for permission.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy started.
elaine: Next steps: (1) Ben - RFC for credit-bucket implementation + admin endpoints (due Wed), (2) Miles - telemetry + alerts (due Wed), (3) Tom - update per-route dashboard and billing gate metric (due Thu), (4) Sara - obtain customer permission for canary (due Thu). Review Fri 9am.
ben: One more engineering caveat: when rolling over, we must avoid double-counting during resume after failover. I'll add dedupe token on ledger writes.
elaine: Good. Also add a short FAQ for sales: "What happens if I exceed my contracted burst?" -> "Soft-throttle until next credit replenishment; emergency on-call can grant temporary credit with audit log."
tom: I'll draft the SLA appendix lines referencing contracted-burst-window and credit expiry.
sara: I'll coordinate comms and include a 7-day expiry notice email template.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy successful 100%
elaine: Great work. We'll confirm legal sign-off and finalize launch checklist on Friday. :raised_hands:
